 Profile Summary 
 
 
 Accomplished Risk & Governance professional with 12+ years of experience at American 
Express, driving operational risk governance, compliance, and control transformation 
initiatives while enabling informed decision -making at senior leadership and Committee 
governance levels. 
 Expertise in implementing risk management frameworks, governance operating models, and 
control assurance mechanisms that strengthen Corporate Functions resilience, enhance 
regulatory readiness, and improve risk maturity across complex business units.  
 Recognized for leveraging Generative AI,  Custom GPT solutions, workflow automation, and 
prompt engineering to modernize governance processes, streamline risk oversight, improve 
control effectiveness, and deliver scalable solutions that elevate operational efficiency and 
decision intelligence. 
 Proven track record of supporting SLT members, and cross -functional leadership teams to 
translate complex risk landscapes into actionable insights, enabling proactive risk mitigation, 
strategic alignment, and sustained business performance. 
 Demonstrated success in delivering measurable financial and risk outcomes through large-
scale remediation programs, data privacy governance initiatives, data protection controls, and 
enterprise transformation efforts, fostering a culture of accountability, compliance, and 
continuous improvement. 
 Worked cross -functionally with RAU, RCSA, and BCM teams , enhancing knowledge of risk 
identification, control assessment, and business continuity practices.  
 Career Highlights/Key Projects & Business Impacts 
 Risk Committee Governance: Designed and implemented Committee calendars, API-enabled 
trackers using AI , and governance workflows, improving planning, transparency, 
accountability, and leadership oversight 
 AI Risk Governance: Developed Committee-ready risk narratives, Committee checklists, and 
control mappings using AI prompt engineering and Custom GPT , enhancing governance 
effectiveness and decision -making, reducing manual effort by 4 FTEs and saving ~1000 hours 
per quarter 
 Data Privacy & Data Protection (Phishing + PII) - Designed and rolled out a training, 
awareness, follow -up programs and new controls , targeting phishing risk and PII data 
exposure, achieved an 84% reduction in phishing clicks and a 67% reduction in unsecured PII 
data storage across 6K+ employees 
 Alteryx Quality Check Automation - Automated the incentive QC review process using 
Alteryx, eliminating manual effort equivalent to 4 FTEs while reviewing 53 incentive plans 
across ~4.6K employees, covering a USD 2.8M incentive pool 
 Write-Off Remediation Project - Identified client underpayment by recalculating incentive 
data across 5 years of historical records; led end-to-end remediation resulting in USD 11M in 
payouts disbursed to affected clients 
 Signing Bonus Claw -Back Initiative - Uncovered missed recovery of signing bonuses by 
auditing client contracts spanning 10 years and recovered USD 560K in unclaimed signing 
bonus amounts 
 Control Effectiveness - Strengthened compliance controls and payment validation processes, 
preventing erroneous payouts and delivering approximately $6.2M in cost avoidance
